entries.summary: Captured booking cloud-sdk reference patterns for entity/DAO/DynamoModule/MessagingModule/IT to mirror in VAS AWS migration phase.
entries.detail:
Closest analog: booking carrierspotrates SpotRatesToInttraRefDetail/Dao/IT.
Entity pattern: @Table(name=...)+@DynamoDbBean; getters @DynamoDbPartitionKey, @DynamoDbAttribute("x"), @DynamoDbConvertedBy(Converter.class), @DynamoDbSecondaryPartitionKey(indexNames=IDX)+@GsiConfig(indexName=IDX, projection=ProjectionType.KEYS_ONLY). cloud-sdk provides com.inttra.mercury.cloudsdk.database.converter.DateEpochSecondAttributeConverter (Date->epoch-seconds Number) = drop-in for VAS DateToEpochSecond. NOTE: booking marks expiresOn with @TTL; VAS design says do NOT use native TTL -> use DateEpochSecondAttributeConverter WITHOUT @TTL to keep plain Number attr.
DAO pattern: inject DatabaseRepository<T, DefaultPartitionKey<String>>; findByHashKey via DefaultQuerySpec.builder().partitionKeyValue(CloudAttributeValue.ofString(key)).consistentRead(true).build() then repository.query(spec); repository.save(entity).
DynamoModule: provide DynamoDbClientConfig = config.getDynamoDbConfig().toClientConfigBuilder().consistentRead(...).build(); per-DAO provider via DynamoRepositoryFactory.createEnhancedRepository(clientConfig, prefix+Table.name, domainType, DynamoRepositoryConfig.builder().domainType(...).build()).
MessagingModule: provide NotificationService = NotificationClientFactory.createDefaultClient(topicArn).
Audit backward-compat: booking uses booking.dynamodb.Audit + @DynamoDbConvertedBy(AuditAttributeConverter.class) on getAudit() (stored as Map). Audit fields use @JsonDeserialize(OffsetDateTimeTypeConverter) + @JsonFormat.
IT pattern: extends com.inttra.mercury.test.dynamodb.BaseDynamoDbIT, @Tag("integration"); createTableWithGsi/createGsi; new EnhancedDynamoRepository<>(dynamoDbClient, enhancedClient, TABLE, Class, repoConfig).
Converters to still examine in AWS phase: booking AuditAttributeConverter; commons dynamo DynamoSupport (Jackson config), OffsetDateTimeTypeConverter (ISO format), DateToEpochSecond; cloud-sdk generic-Object/JSON-string converter availability.

entries.summary: DECISION: 2-commit split. Commit1=OWASP(commons1.0.28)+full prod cloud-sdk migration(compiles/boots/clears CVEs). Commit2=comprehensive IT+coverage+docs. Forced by commons 1.0.28 removing messaging.* and CVE-fix requiring AWS SDK v1 removal.
entries.detail:
Blocker discovered: commons 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT REMOVES com.inttra.mercury.messaging.* (EventLogger/EventPublisher/SNSEventPublisher/SNSClient) — replaced by com.inttra.mercury.cloudsdk.notification.*/cloudsdk.messaging.* in cloud-sdk-api/aws (no shim; commons 1.0.28 has zero messaging classes). VAS imports these directly (ValueAddedServiceModule, HapagLloyd clients) so commons bump alone won't compile. Also, clearing AWS-SDK-v1 CVEs requires dropping dynamo-client (aws-java-sdk 1.12.x). dynamo-client 1.R.01.023 does NOT depend on commons (self-contained), so it CAN coexist at Maven level, but its AWS SDK v1 CVEs would remain. Prompt is self-contradictory (Constraint3=TWO commits vs Step5/DoD=one) and ties CVE-resolution to the OWASP commit ('2 http false-positive CVEs remain'). User unavailable -> deciding autonomously.
DECISION (Option 1): Commit1 (OWASP, msg contains ION-16110) = bump commons 1.0.28 + add cloud-sdk-api/aws + FULL production cloud-sdk migration (SNS NotificationService + DynamoDB DatabaseRepository), remove dynamo-client + prod AWS SDK v1, keep test-scoped aws-java-sdk-dynamodb for DynamoDB Local; update existing unit tests to stay green; verify boot; rerun OWASP to confirm CVEs cleared. Commit2 (AWS hardening, ION-16110) = DynamoDB-Local integration tests (BaseDynamoDbIT), backward-compat round-trip fidelity tests, JaCoCo coverage top-ups, docs. Rationale: only split where commit1 compiles+boots AND resolves CVEs (requires AWS SDK v1 removed). Both commits build green.

entries.summary: Backward-compat plan locked: reuse cloud-sdk DateEpochSecond + OffsetDateTime converters; Audit as nested @DynamoDbBean; PORT DynamoSupport/GZip into VAS for carrierResponse/inttraResponse byte-identical custom format.
entries.detail:
Backward-compat DynamoDB wire formats (from mercury-services-commons sources):
1) expiresOn: dynamo DateToEpochSecond = Date->Long(getTime()/1000) stored N. cloud-sdk DateEpochSecondAttributeConverter = Date->N(getTime()/1000). IDENTICAL -> reuse com.inttra.mercury.cloudsdk.database.converter.DateEpochSecondAttributeConverter (do NOT add @TTL; keep plain Number attr per design).
2) Audit: v1 @DynamoDBDocument stored as Map(M), timestamps via dynamo OffsetDateTimeTypeConverter.convert()=ISO_DATE_TIME (=> 'Z' for UTC). cloud-sdk OffsetDateTimeTypeConverter uses ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME (identical output for OffsetDateTime). Plan: Audit -> @DynamoDbBean (no @Table); timestamp getters @DynamoDbConvertedBy(cloud-sdk OffsetDateTimeTypeConverter); keep @JsonFormat for REST path (decoupled). Enhanced client omits null attrs and does NOT call converter on null, so null lastModifiedDateUtc safe. Prove via round-trip IT.
3) carrierResponse(Object)/inttraResponse(ValueAddedServiceResponse): v1 converters delegate to dynamo DynamoSupport.objectToString/stringToObject -> CUSTOM format '<fqcn>:<json>' or '<len>|<fqcn>:<base64(gzip(json))>' (threshold 300KB), Jackson mapper FAIL_ON_UNKNOWN_PROPERTIES=false, stored S. NO cloud-sdk equivalent -> PORT DynamoSupport + GZip + DynamoSupportException into VAS (dynamo-client being removed) and write CarrierResponseAttributeConverter/InttraResponseAttributeConverter (AttributeConverter, type S) delegating to ported DynamoSupport for byte-identical output. This is the top fidelity risk (generic Object path).
Booking reference AuditAttributeConverter uses Jackson->Map(M) w/ ISO_DATE_TIME (alternative approach). VAS will use nested-bean approach per design doc.

entries.detail:
Baseline OWASP (develop jar value-added-service-1.0.jar, commons 1.R.01.023): 25 vulnerabilities = 6 HIGH, 19 MEDIUM. HIGH (distinct CVE IDs): jackson-databind 2.21.0 CVE-2026-54512, CVE-2026-54513 (fixed in 2.21.4); httpcore5 5.4 / httpcore5-h2 5.3.4 CVE-2026-54399, CVE-2026-54428 (the expected 'http false positives' that remain). No aws-java-sdk v1 CVE flagged (CPE not matched). Report copied to C:\temp\latest-dep-chk-reports\vas\baseline\ (html+json). CVE fix versions: jackson HIGH end<2.21.4; MEDIUM CVE-2026-54515 end<2.21.5. jackson 2.21.4 AND 2.22.0 present in .m2.
Fix approach (mirror booking pom 1.0.27 template): set jackson.version=2.21.4 + dependencyManagement jackson-bom import; bump commons to 1.0.28-SNAPSHOT; add cloud-sdk-api+cloud-sdk-aws (1.0.28); add dynamo-integration-test (test) + aws-java-sdk-dynamodb 1.12.721 (test); REMOVE dynamo-client + prod aws-java-sdk-dynamodb 1.12.652 + mercury.dynamodbclient.version. Expected post-fix: jackson HIGH cleared, only 2 httpcore5 HIGH remain (false positives).
Also confirmed actual DynamoDB table = inttra_int_ValueAddedService => cloud-sdk BaseDynamoDbConfig environment=inttra_int -> tablePrefix inttra_int_ + Table.name ValueAddedService = same. BaseDynamoDbConfig requires environment + readCapacityUnits + writeCapacityUnits (@NotNull @Min1) + optional region/endpointOverride/sseEnabled; toClientConfigBuilder() sets tablePrefix=environment+'_', resolves region via DefaultAwsRegionProviderChain then config, uses DefaultCredentialsProvider.
cloud-sdk DynamoDbAdminCommand<Config>(entityClasses) derives table/GSI/TTL from annotations; override resolveClientConfig -> dynamoConfig.toClientConfigBuilder().consistentRead(false).build().
